name: second-read
description: Second Read: the colleague you send it to before you hit send. Reviews marketing copy (emails, social posts, landing pages, blog posts) and technical docs (READMEs, tutorials, how-tos, reference, release notes), proves every fix with a quote and a named rule, leaves correct details alone, and rewrites without inventing facts. The editor proposes source-anchored edits in reading order and exports the draft you approve. Read it twice. Send it once.

interface.shortDescription: A second read for your copy and your docs
interface.longDescription: Reviews emails, social posts, landing pages, blog posts and technical docs before they go out. Every fix comes with a quote and a named rule; correct details are left alone; rewrites invent no facts.
defaultPrompt: Give this email a second read before I send it.
Is this landing page ready to publish?
Give this README a second read.
Edit this essay for flow and show me the changes first.
